name: tool-showdown
description: Name two tools, like "OpenTofu vs Terraform". Your agent searches daily.dev for comparisons, migration stories and recent news on both, marks which posts come from a vendor, reads the comments, and gives a verdict with its evidence. If daily.dev has too little, it says so.
